levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the five steps (wet, soap, scrub, rinse, dry) is missing or done out of order.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five steps are present and completed in the modeled order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All five steps are present and in order, and the learner explains why the order matters, such as soap needing to go on before scrubbing lifts germs off skin.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Scrubbing covers only palms, for noticeably less than twenty seconds.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Scrubbing covers the backs of hands, between fingers, and under nails for close to twenty seconds.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner independently times the twenty seconds without being reminded.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner cannot name any specific difference between their baseline wash and the full sequence.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner names at least one specific step that was missing from their baseline wash.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner names the missing step and explains specifically why skipping it matters.

lookFors: The learner sings or counts through a full twenty seconds rather than estimating.
The reflection response names a specific step, not a general 'I wash better now.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
